name: dev-server
description: Starts the project's server in /workspace at every boot of the sandbox, for the agent's own checks (a helper restarts it), and, with a port, a second time in a container of its own next to the sandbox: from the agent's checkout, restarted whenever a file changes, published as a button on the run's session. The sandbox itself publishes nothing; the agent's code never runs on the host, and the demo container gets what the sibling plugins hand the sandbox, and the agent's home (Claude's login) only when asked to, and nothing else of yours. Nothing configured → does nothing.

settings.label: Command
settings.description: Run in /workspace at every boot of the sandbox, and in the demo container when a port is set (there it must listen on 0.0.0.0). Empty: nothing is started.

settings.label: Demo port
settings.description: The port the command listens on: set, the command also runs in a demo container next to the sandbox, restarted on every change, published on this machine where the web UI listens and shown on the run's session. Needs agent-workspace. Empty: no demo container.

settings.label: Demo setup commands
settings.description: Shell commands run in the demo container alone, in /workspace, in order, before the command first starts: what the demo needs that the sandbox must not have (credentials of its own, seed data).

settings.label: Agent home in the demo
settings.description: The demo container mounts the agent's home too, as the sandbox has it (Claude: the run's copy of your ~/.claude, its login included). Off: the demo gets no login of yours.
